title: Fetchlinks post record (contract v1)
description: A normalized, destination-neutral post carrying one or more external URLs. Contains no database-generated identifiers.

unique_id.description: Natural deduplication key derived from the post's sorted URLs.

source.description: Human-meaningful origin of the post, e.g. a site or subreddit URL.

source_type.description: Collector that produced the record. A free-form lowercase token so a new source needs no contract change.

direct_link.description: Permalink to the post itself. Empty when the source has no distinct permalink.

urls.description: External URLs in collection order. Array position is the authoritative ordering.
